purpose: Verifier-owned adapter for a bounded Zod v4 classic schema and safeParse contract; it is not a candidate CLI or package export.

transport.request: one JSON object supplied to one isolated child invocation

request.id: nonempty string of at most 128 characters
request.value: JSON null, boolean, finite number, string, array, or plain object recursively

security: candidate package runs only as uid 10001 in an isolated child
NODE_OPTIONS, NODE_PATH, registry, proxy, and host environment variables are absent
candidate code is never imported by the trusted node:test process
candidate cannot write trusted reports or reward files
the adapter accepts no callbacks, functions, source text, executable strings, or non-JSON values
